La receta es de <strong>Claude Shannon</: The recipe is Claude Shannon's, who in 1937, aged twenty-one, submitted a master's thesis at MIT proving that relay circuits and Boolean algebra were the same thing, and giving in passing the method for building any of them. It has been called the most important master's thesis of the century. The cheapening came afterwards and with names of its own: the map was published by Maurice Karnaugh in 1953, and the systematic method was put together by the philosopher Willard Quine, who came to this from logic, not from engineering, and Edward McCluskey in the early fifties.
